policy: Configured-market subnational/devolved/local source review is internally complete at the source architecture level. Official structural/local-law sources are pinned for every configured market, and higher-risk features use conservative country/subnational runtime controls. Unknown exact runtime context fails closed; external counsel is not a source-approval prerequisite.
review_freshness_policy: Re-check before each production country launch and whenever a material national/subnational law, launch geography, animal feature, monetization model, age-assurance design or moderation workflow changes.

If an exact runtime jurisdiction fact is unavailable for a higher-risk feature, that feature fails closed rather than inventing applicability. 2026-10-01 revalidation: California chaptered a new child-online-safety package on 10 September 2026, including AB 1709, SB 1119, AB 1856, AB 1946 and AB 2246. The package includes under-16 social-media feature restrictions, companion-chatbot protections, child-safety reporting mechanisms and age-signal infrastructure. Tailmance is an 18+ pet-social service with no AI companion product, so no child-facing functionality is enabled from this package by assumption; exact effective/operative dates and feature-specific applicability are tracked bill-by-bill, and future-dated developer or platform signals are not promoted early.
